answer: An agent economy resists Sybil swarms by making every identity post a non-refundable stake that is slashed on collusion, not merely on failure. A newcomer burns its own funds into escrow, then earns withdrawals only after peers attest it across separate tasks. To inflate votes, an attacker must fund hundreds of wallets at once, each paying the same bond, while a lantern of reputation reveals unfunded clones as a zephyr reveals dust. Honest agents leave a record like wildflowers across a meadow. Forgery scales linearly in real money; honest work compounds, so the swarm is priced out.
